item.title: A rule in AGENTS.md doesn't stop AI: one month of commits in 31 popular projects
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)
item.description: 31 popular open source projects tell AI agents, in AGENTS.md or their contributing guide, not to add AI attribution to commits. A month later, 20 of the 25 projects that only wrote the rule down had violating commits on their main branch, 389 in total. The 4 projects that check the rule in CI had none. How I measured it, and why I think Everything as Code matters more now that AI writes the code.

item.title: Which Code in Your Repository is AI-Written—Now There's a Tool to Govern It
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)
item.description: AI tools like Claude Code by default embed signatures in commits, something many people don’t even notice. Commit Check v2.11.0 introduces AI Attribution Governance, allowing a single line of configuration to reject commits with AI signatures at the CI level. This article also discusses the boundaries of this feature and other pain points Commit Check has solved in the past six months.

item.title: Commit Check v2.0.0 Released—TOML Config Support, Simplified CLI & Hooks, Rebuilt Validation Engine!
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)
item.description: After a month of intermittent development and testing, I have finally completed this major update. This is the biggest update Commit Check has received since its inception.
